# Mechanical research sources v1.8.2

Primary/official references consulted for sequence order:

- Beretta APX A1 / APX user manuals: semiautomatic slide cycle, extraction/ejection, return spring and last-round slide lock.
  - https://www.beretta.com/content/dam/beretta-usa/user-manuals/APX_A1_Manual.pdf
  - https://www.beretta.com/content/dam/beretta/manuals/pistols/apx/C6A123_002_ENG_digital_A4.pdf
- Mossberg pump-action owner manuals: rearward forearm motion extracts/ejects; forward motion feeds/chambers.
  - https://resources.mossberg.com/hubfs/manuals/12173-Owners-Manual-Pumps-English.pdf
  - https://resources.mossberg.com/hubfs/manuals/590DA.pdf
- Winchester Model 70 owner manual: cycle bolt rearward to eject after each shot, then forward to feed/chamber.
  - https://www.winchesterguns.com/support/owners-manuals/model-70.html
- US Marine Corps M240B Medium Machine Gun student handout: open-bolt belt-fed cycle, feed pawls and bolt movement.
  - https://www.trngcmd.marines.mil/Portals/207/Docs/TBS/B3M4178%20M240B%20Medium%20Machine%20Gun.pdf
- Smith & Wesson public revolver descriptions/manual resources: double-action trigger advances cylinder and cocks/releases hammer; extractor handles cases during unloading/reload.
  - https://www.smith-wesson.com/customer-service/owners-manuals

The exact millisecond timings and gains in the showcase are perceptual synthesis tunings, not universal mechanical measurements. Real recordings vary with model, ammunition, lubrication, wear, microphone position and environment.
